description: Land Aquisition - Ramukoluwa, Laggala Palleyama D/S Division, Matale District.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents, along with the legal authority for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), the core content is focused on land/property matters rather than government structure or personnel changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
